description: Removes an agency's Cofounderbase directory listing and its awards nominee page, at the request of someone at that agency. Step 1: call with target (the agency website or its Cofounderbase slug) and the user's own work email, which must be on the agency's website domain (Gmail, Outlook and other free-mail are refused). We email a 6-digit code to that address; the code is never shown in the chat. Step 2: call again with the same target and email plus the code the user typed. Only call this when the user asks to remove their own agency. To edit a listing instead, send them to the Claim link on the listing page.

code.description: The 6-digit code from the email (step 2 only).

email.description: The user's own email on the agency domain, typed by them.

target.description: The agency website (e.g. northwind.ai) or its Cofounderbase slug.

name: directory_request_removal

message.description: One or two sentences to show the user as they are.

title: Remove a listing
